fusions.name: Skipping Mote
fusions.desc: Flicks a mote of arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Pounce Nova
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto your target, then release a ring of arcana that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Between Blinks
fusions.desc: Blinks you to a point up to 8 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Mote Spill
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, a leaping mote of arcana deals 5 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 6 seconds.
